title: Northwind Health: integration sync failure
transcript:
Agent: Northwind support, this is Elena. How can I help?
Customer: Hi Elena, this is Marcus from Northwind Health. Our integration stopped syncing this morning. None of the new patient records are showing up in the platform.
Agent: I am sorry about that. Can you confirm the account ID and which integration you mean?
Customer: Account 2210. It is the EHR connector. We use it for patient intake and scheduling.
Agent: I see the connector. It last synced at 6:42 this morning, and then it started returning authentication errors. Did anything change on your side, such as a password reset or an admin permission change?
Customer: Actually, yes. Our IT team forced a password reset for the service account yesterday afternoon.
Agent: That explains it. The connector uses an API token tied to that service account. When the password changes, the token is invalidated. I can reset the token from here, but the connector may need to be re-authorized on your side.
Customer: Okay. Can you walk me through it?
Agent: I have reset the token. In the admin console, go to Settings, then Integrations, then EHR Connector. You should see a prompt to re-authorize. Once you click that, the sync should resume within five minutes.
Customer: I see the prompt. I am clicking it now. It says authorization successful.
Agent: Good. I can see the connector come back online. The backlog is starting to process. I will create a ticket for this so we have a record, and I will schedule a follow-up for July 13 to confirm the sync is stable.
Customer: That works. Is there anything else we should do?
Agent: If you change the service account password again, click re-authorize afterward. I will add that note to the ticket.
Customer: Thanks, Elena. That was quick.
Agent: You are welcome. I will send the ticket number and the follow-up details by email.
